_about: The one place that says which model and which thinking level every step of the chain uses (agreed 2026-10-15). Every tool reads it through run_config.py; nothing else names a model. An environment variable can override a group's model for an experiment: TSDAF_WORKFLOW_MODEL, TSDAF_VISION_MODEL, TSDAF_OCSR_MODEL. Credentials are not here: OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY from the process environment only.

workflow._about: the reading of the paper: SI segmentation, the record of every experiment entry, the paper-level task
workflow._model_note: Gemini-4-argon in the grey test on lpzproxy

vision._about: the small image readings: the pre-stage's reading of cut-out lines, figure and scheme transcripts, printed labels of the drawings, whose compound a figure without running text belongs to, the check of the detector boxes before they go to the OCSR side

ocsr._about: structures of the drawings. Our side: the molecule detector boxes every drawing of the figures the pre-stage transcribes, the figure reader gives the printed label beside each box, and after the record the chain binds each box to a compound of the result by that label (bound boxes are the drawings the result needs). The collaborator's side: the SMILES of those boxes (OCSR), returned per box.
ocsr._results_note: relative to the workspace: <paper>.ocsr.json returned by the OCSR side, {detection_id: {smiles, inchi_key, formula, readable, is_abstract, confidence}}, detection_id being '<figure file>#<mark>' as written in structure-binding.json; while it is absent the bound boxes carry no structure yet

detector._about: the molecule detector run before the figures are transcribed (the same as for the five reference papers)
detector._where: machine-specific, from the process environment: TSDAF_DETECTOR_PYTHON (a Python with torch and ultralytics), TSDAF_DETECTOR_WEIGHTS (the file of the weights named here), TSDAF_DETECTOR_DEVICE (cuda, mps or cpu). Without them prestage_paper.py reads a paper's figure-labels/<rid>.detections.json made elsewhere, or reads the figures unmarked and says so.
